parameters.query: WITH candidate AS (SELECT s.id FROM system_events s JOIN content_posts p ON p.id = s.entity_id WHERE s.event_type IN ('telegram_regenerate_text', 'telegram_regenerate_both') AND NOT (s.payload ? 'processed_at') AND NOT (s.payload ? 'claimed_at') AND p.approval_status IN ('regenerating_text', 'regenerating_both') ORDER BY s.id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED), claimed AS (UPDATE system_events s SET payload = s.payload || jsonb_build_object('claimed_at', now()) FROM candidate WHERE s.id = candidate.id RETURNING s.id AS event_id, s.event_type, s.entity_id AS post_id) SELECT claimed.event_id, claimed.event_type, p.id AS current_post_id, p.pillar AS current_pillar, p.hook AS current_hook, p.body AS current_body, p.cta AS current_cta, p.hashtags AS current_hashtags, p.image_brief AS current_image_brief, p.image_path AS current_image_path, e.id AS evidence_id, e.kind, e.title, e.situation, e.action_text, e.result_text, e.source_ref, e.proof_level, e.confidentiality, e.approved_claims, e.tags FROM claimed JOIN content_posts p ON p.id = claimed.post_id JOIN evidence_items e ON e.id = p.evidence_id;

WITH deleted_claims AS (DELETE FROM claim_map WHERE post_id = $2::uuid), updated AS (UPDATE content_posts SET pillar = $3, hook = $4, body = $5, cta = $6, hashtags = $7::text[], image_brief = $8, image_path = CASE WHEN $1 = 'telegram_regenerate_both' THEN NULL ELSE image_path END, image_model = CASE WHEN $1 = 'telegram_regenerate_both' THEN NULL ELSE image_model END, risk_flags = $9::text[], approval_status = $10, reviewer_notes = NULL, approved_at = NULL, scheduled_at = NULL, text_model = $11, openai_response_id = NULLIF($12, ''), token_usage = COALESCE(token_usage, '{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object('text_regeneration', NULLIF($13, '')::jsonb) WHERE id = $2::uuid AND approval_status IN ('regenerating_text', 'regenerating_both') RETURNING id), inserted_claims AS (INSERT INTO claim_map (post_id, evidence_id, claim_text, allowed, reason) SELECT updated.id, NULLIF(claim->>'evidence_id', '')::uuid, claim->>'claim', COALESCE((claim->>'allowed')::boolean, false), COALESCE(claim->>'reason', '') FROM updated CROSS JOIN jsonb_array_elements($14::jsonb) AS claim), event_done AS (UPDATE system_events SET payload = payload || jsonb_build_object('processed_at', now()) WHERE id = $15::bigint RETURNING id) SELECT updated.id AS post_id, $10 AS approval_status, ($1 = 'telegram_regenerate_both') AS image_regeneration_required FROM updated, event_done;
